name: Process condensate treatment and sour water stripping
description: Process condensate treatment and sour water stripping | Effluent / wastewater treatment (ammonia stripping and urea hydrolysis) Primary source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sour_gas

specifications.unit: mg H2S per m3 natural gas (~4 ppmv at STP)
specifications.basis: Natural gas usually considered sour above this level; Texas Railroad Commission uses >100 ppmv for pipelines, TCEQ >24 ppmv upstream

specifications.metric: Effluent quantity from urea synthesis reaction
specifications.basis: One mole of water formed per mole of urea from 2NH3 + CO2
Adds ~150 kg/t urea wash/flushing water and ejector drive steam plus intermittent discharges; for a 1700 t/d plant about 850 m3/day
Indicative composition stated in patent description (a second table gives CO2 1-1.25 wt%)
specifications.value: NH3 2-5 wt%; CO2 1-2.5 wt%; urea 0.5-2 wt%; balance water

specifications.basis: Hydrolysis of urea/biuret at 200-240 C and 20-40 bar gauge; longer time has no appreciable effect
Stripping stages at 128-150 C; live steam to column base or reboiler

specifications.metric: Treated effluent residual NH3 and urea
specifications.basis: Residual content of between 10 and 0.4 ppm for each pollutant; below 1 ppm possible with preferred conditions, suitable as boiler feed water up to 110 bar steam

specifications.metric: Process condensate treatment in urea plant boundary
specifications.basis: Pusri urea EPD cradle-to-gate system boundary includes crystallizer, prilling and process condensate treatment
